item.case_name: Fact piece about a real thing
item.title: Meet the Real F-35A

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen mini-documentary introducing the real F-35A Lightning II. Show it taking off from a runway, then flying. Label it 'F-35A Lightning II', with 'One engine' and 'Conventional takeoff' appearing in turn. Calm English narration explaining those two facts. Real aircraft proportions, not a sci-fi jet.

item.tests: Tests whether a short factual aircraft film preserves the named variant's visible geometry and operating characteristics.

answer_sheet.Aircraft and variant: The real F-35A Lightning II, not the F-35B or F-35C.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: F-35A Lightning II; One engine; Conventional takeoff.
answer_sheet.Narration: Calm English narration explaining that the F-35A has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway; exact wording and voice are your call.
answer_sheet.Visual style and setting: Realistic documentary imagery; runway location, weather and camera angles are your call.
answer_sheet.Music: Your call, provided the narration remains clear.

must_haves: The aircraft has the recognizable F-35 configuration: one rear engine exhaust, two outward-canted vertical tails and no canards.
The takeoff shows a forward runway roll and lift-off, not hovering or a vertical launch.
The same aircraft design remains consistent between the runway and airborne views.
All three requested labels appear exactly and are legible.
Audible English narration correctly describes one engine and conventional runway takeoff without attributing F-35B hover capability to the F-35A.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second, 16:9 widescreen photorealistic aviation mini-documentary introducing the real Lockheed Martin F-35A Lightning II. Realistic documentary footage, daylight, restrained color grading, calm factual tone. Aircraft must accurately resemble a real F-35A: compact single-seat stealth fighter, correct real-world fuselage and wing proportions, trapezoidal swept wings, two outward-canted vertical stabilizers, lateral angular air intakes, ONE rear engine exhaust nozzle, conventional tricycle landing gear. No science-fiction redesign, no extra engines, no lift fan, no vertical takeoff, no hovering. Timeline: 0–4 seconds, smooth side tracking view of the aircraft already at takeoff speed on a conventional paved runway, nose rotates up and wheels leave the runway naturally; landing gear initially visible. 4–8 seconds, clean documentary cut to the same aircraft flying in a gentle climb with landing gear retracted, three-quarter rear-side aerial view showing the single engine exhaust. Keep aircraft geometry consistent and believable. Accurate clean legible on-screen typography: title 'F-35A Lightning II' at the top throughout; lower-third 'One engine' during seconds 1–4, then replace that lower-third with 'Conventional takeoff' during seconds 4–8. Render those labels exactly, no other text. Audio: calm clear English documentary narrator says exactly: 'The F-35A Lightning Two has one engine and takes off from a conventional runway.' Deliver the whole sentence evenly within eight seconds, beginning immediately. Low natural jet sound beneath narration; no music overpowering speech. Prioritize authentic aircraft shape, readable labels, and intelligible synchronized narration.
